checkSeal (src/memory-seal.ts:102-115) detects divergence by comparing sha256(current content) to the stored digest and returns 'diverged' when they differ
SealStatus type is defined at src/memory-seal.ts:24 and DIVERGED_BODY constant at src/memory-seal.ts:117
SEAL_FILE, sealPath, sealKey, digest exported constants/helpers are at src/memory-seal.ts:26, 35-37, 40-42, 44-46 respectively
writeSeal (src/memory-seal.ts:57-63) is the function that writes memory/.seal.json via a temp-file + atomic rename.
sealPath (src/memory-seal.ts:35-37) resolves the target path to memory/.seal.json.
